answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The counter asks for Girthbound harness hall keeper collar seal first, and a seal harness hall keepers renew after guild hall hearings is the answer it accepts. Nobody is waved through free: a fare of £9 for the journey to the registry, paid per name is the price, and the pigment never covers it twice. lagoon is written on the receipt. sonnet stays on the record.
